subject: Your volunteering at Essência starts soon
message:
Hey {{name}},

We are looking forward to you! Thank you for supporting us at Essência from {{arrival}}.

Attached you find some useful information in advance:

- How to get to Essência
- Fire-Awareness Guide

A friendly reminder: Essência is a substance-free and plant-based community, and smoking is not permitted on our land. Thank you for helping us keep it a peaceful place for everyone!

You can join our Telegram group with your personal link:
{{telegramJoinLink}}

If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

Até já,
Your Essência Community
